title: Origins and Road to War
sub: How the War in Southern Vietnam began

slides.title: From Indochina Wars to War in Southern Vietnam
slides.cap: Historical connection: Partition and insurgency in Vietnam
slides.body: The Indochina Wars left Vietnam divided after the defeat of France. Rival governments, communist insurgency, and outside intervention transformed the southern struggle into the central battlefield of the Vietnam War.

stats.lbl: The Indochina Wars left Vietnam divided after the defeat of France. Rival governments, communist insurgency, and outside intervention transformed the southern struggle into the central battlefield of the Vietnam War.

slides.title: Before the War in Southern Vietnam
slides.body:
Vietnam's post-Geneva division left rival governments in Hanoi and Saigon. Communist cadres and southern insurgents challenged the South Vietnamese state.

The Conflict Takes Shape: The conflict concerned Vietnamese reunification, the survival of South Vietnam, and the credibility of American containment policy. The opening phase established the political goals, alliances, and military problems that shaped every later campaign.

stats.val: The conflict concerned Vietnamese reunification, the survival of South Vietnam, and the credibility of American containment policy.

slides.title: War in southern Vietnam
slides.body:
War in southern Vietnam marked an important episode in the War in Southern Vietnam. It showed how the conflict's political goals were being translated into military action and placed new pressure on both the battlefield and surrounding communities.

Why This Moment Matters: War in southern Vietnam was more than an isolated engagement. It helped define the conflict's direction and exposed the strengths and weaknesses of the opposing sides. The conflict concerned Vietnamese reunification, the survival of South Vietnam, and the credibility of American containment policy.

Consequences: The effects of War in southern Vietnam extended beyond its immediate result. Guerrilla warfare, bombing, forced relocation, and political violence devastated rural communities. Its place in the wider campaign also influenced later military choices and political calculations.

title: International and Human Dimensions
sub: The wider impact of the War in Southern Vietnam

slides.title: International Dimension
slides.body:
North Vietnam supported the insurgency, while the United States escalated from advisers to a large combat force and extensive air power.

The Human Cost: Guerrilla warfare, bombing, forced relocation, and political violence devastated rural communities.

title: Outcome and Legacy
sub: How the War in Southern Vietnam ended and what followed

slides.title: The End of the War in Southern Vietnam
slides.body: North Vietnamese forces captured Saigon in 1975, ending South Vietnam and reunifying the country under communist rule.
